title: EndoNav: Semantic-to-Geometric Grounding for Language-Guided Robotic Endoscopic Examination
summary: Minimally invasive procedures performed within confined anatomical spaces depend on continuous endoscopic visualization. Current robotic endoscope systems can stabilize or reposition an endoscope, but they do not possess relevant context to provide effective visualization assistance. We present EndoNav, an anatomy-grounded natural-language framework that translates high-level surgeon commands into autonomous endoscopic visualization behaviors within patient-specific sinonasal anatomy. Spoken surgeon commands are transcribed and interpreted by an endoscopic viewpoint agent conditioned on a patient-specific anatomical scene representation. Rather than generating robot motion directly, the viewpoint agent generates structured visualization objectives that are converted into target viewpoints and inspection trajectories, which are then executed through geometry-constrained endoscope motion planning and joint-space control. We evaluate EndoNav using a structured three-pass sinus examination across three CT-derived anatomical models. For one cadaveric specimen, autonomous visualization is compared with sinus examinations performed by two resident surgeons. EndoNav achieved mean visualization IoUs of 87.04% and 84.37% relative to the two surgeon examinations, compared with an inter-surgeon IoU of 87.44%, while recovering 92.91% and 93.20% of surgeon-observed anatomical surfaces, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of grounding high-level anatomical commands into patient-specific geometric objectives and translating them into anatomically constrained robotic visualization behaviors.
tldr: EndoNav translates high-level surgeon commands into autonomous endoscopic visualization behaviors by grounding semantic instructions into patient-specific geometric objectives, achieving visualization performance comparable to human surgeons in sinus examination.
tldr_zh: EndoNav将外科医生的高级指令转化为自主内窥镜可视化行为，通过将语义指令与患者特定的几何目标相结合，在鼻窦检查中实现了与人类外科医生相当的可视化性能。
summary_zh: 在受限解剖空间内进行的微创手术依赖于持续的内镜可视化。当前机器人内镜系统能够稳定或重新定位内镜，但缺乏提供有效可视化辅助的相关情境。我们提出EndoNav，一种基于解剖结构的自然语言框架，可将高级外科医生指令转化为针对患者特定鼻窦解剖结构的自主内镜可视化行为。外科医生的语音指令通过内镜视角代理进行转录和解释，该代理以患者特定的解剖场景表示为条件。视角代理不直接生成机器人运动，而是生成结构化的可视化目标，这些目标被转换为目标视角和检查轨迹，随后通过几何约束的内镜运动规划和关节空间控制来执行。我们使用结构化三遍鼻窦检查方法，基于三个CT衍生解剖模型评估了EndoNav。对于一具尸体标本，将自主可视化与两位住院外科医生进行的鼻窦检查进行了比较。EndoNav相对于两位外科医生检查的平均可视化IoU分别为87.04%和84.37%，而外科医生间的IoU为87.44%，同时分别恢复了92.91%和93.20%的医生观察到的解剖表面。这些结果证明了将高级解剖指令锚定到患者特定的几何目标，并将其转化为解剖约束下的机器人可视化行为的可行性。

title: Development and Feasibility Evaluation of an Edge AI as Medical Device System for Breast Cancer Multidisciplinary Team Meetings
summary: Breast Cancer Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) meetings manage increasingly complex cases under considerable time pressure, and documentation requirements can reduce clinical efficiency and decision quality. Existing AI based MDT workflows rely on cloud-based processing, limiting their use because patient discussions contain identifiable information. We developed a fully on-device AI pipeline using open-source Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Large Language Models (LLMs) that transcribes breast cancer MDT discussions, structures clinical information, and generates treatment recommendations using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounded in National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidance. The pipeline runs on a single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, ensuring that patient audio, transcripts, and outputs remain within institutional infrastructure. Evaluation included two recorded simulated MDT discussions, ten clinically validated synthetic discussions, and 1,270 acoustically augmented recordings. Optimisation of Whisper large-v3 reduced word error rate by 20.7% and 24.4% on the recorded discussions and achieved performance within 0.58% WER and 1.58% word information lost of a commercial clinical ASR benchmark on augmented audio. MedGemma-RAG identified 2.3 times more MDT-concordant interventions than a proprietary cloud comparator (p = 0.020), with no significant difference in overall accuracy. Stakeholders identified automated documentation, treatment recommendation support, and case triage as the most credible near-term applications while highlighting workflow integration, governance, and clinician trust as key implementation challenges. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving, fully on-device AI for MDT documentation and guideline-informed decision support, providing a foundation for prospective clinical evaluation.
tldr: This paper presents a fully on-device AI pipeline using ASR and LLMs with RAG for breast cancer multidisciplinary team meetings, enabling privacy-preserving transcription, documentation, and guideline-based recommendations, and demonstrates feasibility on a single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种完全在设备上运行的AI流水线，利用自动语音识别和大语言模型结合检索增强生成技术，用于乳腺癌多学科团队会议，实现隐私保护的转录、文档记录和基于指南的建议，并在单个NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上验证了可行性。
summary_zh: 乳腺癌多学科团队（MDT）会议在相当的时间压力下处理日益复杂的病例，而文档记录需求可能降低临床效率和决策质量。现有的基于AI的MDT工作流程依赖云端处理，但由于患者讨论包含可识别信息，其使用受到限制。我们开发了一套完全在设备端运行的AI流程，采用开源自动语音识别（ASR）和大语言模型（LLM），用于转录乳腺癌MDT讨论、结构化临床信息，并基于英国国家健康与临床优化研究所（NICE）指南，通过检索增强生成（RAG）生成治疗建议。该流程在单个NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin设备上运行，确保患者音频、转录文本和输出结果均保留在机构内部基础设施中。评估包括两次录制的模拟MDT讨论、十次临床验证的合成讨论以及1270次声学增强录音。对Whisper large-v3的优化使录制讨论的词错误率降低了20.7%和24.4%，并在增强音频上实现了与商业临床ASR基准相比0.58%的WER和1.58%的单词信息损失。MedGemma-RAG识别出的MDT一致干预措施数量是专有云对照系统的2.3倍（p=0.020），且整体准确率无显著差异。利益相关者认为自动化文档记录、治疗建议支持和病例分诊是最可信的近期应用，同时指出工作流程整合、治理和临床医生信任是关键的实施挑战。这些发现证明了隐私保护型完全设备端AI在MDT文档记录和基于指南的决策支持中的可行性，为前瞻性临床评估奠定了基础。

title: Analyzing and Mitigating Cross-Lingual Degradation in Multilingual Medical VQA
summary: Medical visual question answering (VQA) is a crucial task in clinical AI, yet its evaluation has so far centered almost exclusively on English, limiting its relevance to linguistically diverse patients and clinicians. Recent multilingual medical VQA benchmarks show that large vision-language models (LVLMs) degrade in non-English languages, but lack a fine-grained analysis of how cross-lingual variation affects the distinct capabilities that medical VQA requires. To this end, we construct a multilingual medical VQA benchmark over eight languages, organized into four representative scenarios that isolate the core capabilities medical VQA requires. Evaluating five open- and closed-source LVLMs, we find that cross-lingual degradation is not uniform but highly scenario-dependent. We therefore propose MedVL-XLRepE, a training-free scenario-aware representation engineering method, leveraging LVLMs' superior English medical VQA capability to steer non-English representations toward their English counterparts at inference time. Across three LVLMs and eight languages, MedVL-XLRepE consistently mitigates cross-lingual degradation, with gains of up to 6.33\%.
tldr: This paper analyzes cross-lingual degradation in multilingual medical VQA across eight languages, finding the degradation is scenario-dependent, and proposes a training-free representation engineering method (MedVL-XLRepE) that steers non-English representations toward English ones to consistently mitigate degradation by up to 6.33%.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了多语言医学视觉问答（VQA）中的跨语言退化现象，发现退化具有场景依赖性，并提出了一种无需训练的表示工程方法（MedVL-XLRepE），通过将非英语表示向英语表示引导，持续缓解退化，最高提升6.33%。
summary_zh: 医学视觉问答（VQA）是临床人工智能中的一项关键任务，然而迄今为止其评估几乎完全局限于英语，限制了其对语言多样的患者和临床医生的适用性。近期多语言医学VQA基准表明，大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在非英语语言中性能下降，但缺乏对跨语言变异如何影响医学VQA所需的不同能力的细粒度分析。为此，我们构建了一个覆盖八种语言的多语言医学VQA基准，并将其组织为四个代表性场景，分别隔离了医学VQA所需的核心能力。通过评估五个开源与闭源LVLMs，我们发现跨语言退化并非均匀分布，而是高度依赖场景。因此，我们提出MedVL-XLRepE——一种无需训练、感知场景的表示工程方法，利用LVLMs在英语医学VQA中的优越能力，在推理时将非英语表示引导至其对应的英语表示。在三个LVLMs和八种语言上，MedVL-XLRepE持续缓解了跨语言退化，性能提升高达6.33%。

title: Role-Specialized Mixture-of-Agents with Open-Weight LLMs for Clinical Prediction
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to clinical prediction tasks such as in-hospital mortality and readmission from electronic health records (EHRs). Privacy and compliance constraints motivate systems that can be deployed locally, which has increased interest in open-weight multi-agent designs. However, most medical multi-agent systems are evaluated as a single block, leaving unclear which agent role contributes to prediction and whether retrieval drives observed gains. We study a role-specialized Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) that combines medical knowledge retrieval with contrastive similar-patient reasoning. By varying the role design while holding the retrieval setup fixed, we localize the main effect to the final integrator. Pairing large open-weight analysts with a small open-weight integrator matches closed-model prompting on F1 for mortality prediction while flagging substantially more true high-risk patients. Mechanism analysis shows the role assignment directly yields a high-recall operating point without threshold tuning. The effect is task-dependent, with smaller gains for readmission because the available records correlate weakly with this longer-horizon outcome. These results position role design as a key factor in privacy-constrained, training-free clinical LLM prediction.
tldr: This paper studies a role-specialized Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) framework for clinical prediction tasks from EHRs, showing that pairing a large open-weight analyst with a small open-weight integrator achieves closed-model performance on mortality prediction while significantly increasing true high-risk patient flagging, with the main effect localized to the integrator role.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了一种角色专业化的混合代理（MoA）框架，用于基于电子健康记录的临床预测任务，表明将大型开放权重分析师与小型开放权重集成器配对，在死亡率预测上达到闭源模型性能，同时显著增加对真正高风险患者的标记，且主要效应定位于集成器角色。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被应用于临床预测任务，例如基于电子健康记录（EHRs）预测院内死亡率和再入院率。隐私与合规性约束推动了可本地部署的系统的发展，从而增加了对开源权重多智能体设计的兴趣。然而，大多数医疗多智能体系统作为单一整体进行评估，导致难以明确哪个智能体角色对预测有贡献，以及检索是否带来了观察到的性能提升。我们研究了一种角色专业化的混合智能体（MoA）架构，该架构将医学知识检索与对比相似患者推理相结合。通过固定检索设置并改变角色设计，我们将主要效应定位到最终的整合者。将大型开源权重分析者与小型开源权重整合者配对，在死亡率预测的F1分数上与闭源模型提示方法相当，同时标记出更多真正的高风险患者。机制分析表明，角色分配直接产生了高召回率的工作点，而无需阈值调整。该效应具有任务依赖性：对于再入院预测的增益较小，因为可用记录与这一更长时域结局的相关性较弱。这些结果将角色设计定位为隐私约束下、无训练临床LLM预测的关键因素。

title: TRACE: Artifact-Robust Statistical Shape Modeling from Imperfect Surface Scans - A Case Study in Craniosynostosis 3D Photography
summary: Craniosynostosis severity analysis increasingly relies on statistical shape models (SSMs) to quantify cranial morphology, but most existing workflows depend on computed tomography or heavily curated three-dimensional (3D) photographs. Raw clinical 3D photographs provide a radiation-free and repeatable alternative, yet often contain shoulders, hands, hair, clothing, scanner noise, and incomplete boundaries that corrupt correspondences. We introduce the Template-constrained Robust Artifact-aware Correspondence Estimation (TRACE) framework, an unsupervised method for constructing SSMs directly from artifact-contaminated clinical 3D head photographs. TRACE predicts sparse anatomically corresponding head-surface control points from the raw point cloud, refines them through a coarse-to-fine Surface-Aware Deformation cascade, and uses thin-plate spline warping to deform a clean template mesh into a subject-specific head reconstruction. This template-constrained formulation keeps dense correspondences on clinically relevant head anatomy while suppressing non-head artifacts. The correspondence module is decoupled from the point-cloud encoder, enabling the same deformation pipeline to be paired with different backbones, including PointNet, DGCNN, and Point Transformer V3. Across all backbones, TRACE substantially improves surface sampling, topology preservation, and shape-model quality over prior SSM methods, providing a scalable foundation for photograph-based craniosynostosis shape analysis and a framework that may extend to other artifact-contaminated surface scans when an appropriate clean template is available.
tldr: TRACE is an unsupervised framework that constructs statistical shape models directly from artifact-contaminated 3D head photographs for craniosynostosis analysis, using template-constrained deformation to suppress non-head artifacts and improve correspondence quality.
tldr_zh: TRACE 是一种无监督框架，直接从含有伪影的临床 3D 头部照片构建统计形状模型，用于颅缝早闭分析，通过模板约束变形抑制非头部伪影并提升对应点质量。
summary_zh: 颅缝早闭严重程度分析日益依赖统计形状模型（SSM）来量化颅骨形态，但现有大多数工作流程依赖于计算机断层扫描或经过严格处理的三维照片。原始临床三维照片提供了无辐射且可重复的替代方案，但通常包含肩部、手部、头发、衣物、扫描仪噪声以及不完整的边界，这些都会破坏对应关系。我们提出了模板约束的鲁棒伪影感知对应估计（TRACE）框架，这是一种无监督方法，可直接从受伪影污染的临床三维头部照片构建SSM。TRACE从原始点云中预测稀疏的解剖学对应头部表面控制点，通过由粗到精的表面感知变形级联对其进行优化，并利用薄板样条扭曲将干净的模板网格变形为个体特定的头部重建。这种模板约束的公式在临床相关的头部解剖结构上保持稠密对应，同时抑制非头部伪影。对应模块与点云编码器解耦，使得相同的变形流程能够与不同的骨干网络（包括PointNet、DGCNN和Point Transformer V3）配对使用。在所有骨干网络下，TRACE在表面采样、拓扑保持和形状模型质量方面显著优于先前的SSM方法，为基于照片的颅缝早闭形状分析提供了可扩展的基础，并且该框架在获得合适干净模板的情况下，可推广至其他受伪影污染的表面扫描。

title: CiUNet: A Hybrid Swin-CNN UNet for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation requires high accuracy and robustness, yet practical commercial deployment also demands privacy preservation and computational efficiency. In this context, the U-Net architecture, which can be inherently decoupled into independent encoder and decoder components, serves as a natural commercial choice. However, pure Transformer-based variants like Swin-UNet often suffer from insufficient local detail capture and limited interpretability. In this paper, we propose a lightweight hybrid architecture built upon the Swin-UNet framework. Our model integrates a parallel CNN encoder to complement the shallow layer reasoning of Swin Transformers with local texture features. To bridge the semantic gap and enhance fine-grained spatial detail recovery, we design an asymmetric feature fusion strategy and introduce cross-layer skip (XSkip) connections that explicitly propagate shallow CNN features into the decoder. We further incorporate novel loss functions and an auxiliary supervision head (Aux-Head) to strengthen training stability, boundary delineation, and intermediate feature interpretability. Extensive experiments on the Synapse multi-organ segmentation dataset demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art competitive Dice scores and Hausdorff distances, offering an accurate, efficient, and interpretable solution for clinical deployment.
tldr: This paper proposes CiUNet, a lightweight hybrid Swin-CNN UNet for medical image segmentation, integrating parallel CNN encoder, asymmetric feature fusion, XSkip connections, and auxiliary supervision to improve accuracy and interpretability, achieving state-of-the-art results on the Synapse multi-organ dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CiUNet，一种轻量级混合Swin-CNN UNet用于医学图像分割，集成了并行CNN编码器、非对称特征融合、XSkip连接和辅助监督，以提高准确性和可解释性，在Synapse多器官数据集上取得了最新最优结果。
summary_zh: 摘要：医学图像分割需要高精度和鲁棒性，但实际的商业部署还要求隐私保护和计算效率。在此背景下，U-Net架构因其可自然解耦为独立的编码器和解码器组件，成为一种自然的商业选择。然而，基于纯Transformer的变体（如Swin-UNet）往往存在局部细节捕获不足和可解释性有限的问题。本文提出了一种基于Swin-UNet框架的轻量级混合架构。该模型集成了并行CNN编码器，以局部纹理特征补充Swin Transformer的浅层推理能力。为弥合语义鸿沟并增强细粒度空间细节恢复，我们设计了一种非对称特征融合策略，并引入了跨层跳跃（XSkip）连接，将浅层CNN特征显式传播至解码器。此外，我们引入了新颖的损失函数和辅助监督头（Aux-Head），以增强训练稳定性、边界描绘能力及中间特征的可解释性。在Synapse多器官分割数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在Dice分数和Hausdorff距离上达到了具有竞争力的最先进水平，为临床部署提供了一种准确、高效且可解释的解决方案。
